subject: Geografia
description_pt: Explicar como os processos naturais e históricos atuam na produção e na mudança das paisagens naturais e antrópicas nos seus lugares de vivência, comparando-os a outros lugares.

components.description_pt: Explicar como processos naturais moldam a formação e transformação de paisagens em seu lugar de vivência
components.description_en: Explain how natural processes shape the formation and transformation of landscapes in students' places of experience
components.cc_component_description: Explain how interactions among Earth's major systems shape surface materials and geological processes

components.description_pt: Explicar como processos históricos contribuem para a transformação de paisagens ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Explain how historical processes contribute to the transformation of landscapes over time
components.cc_component_description: Identify how wind and water erosion change the shape of land over time

components.description_pt: Comparar paisagens de seu próprio lugar de vivência com paisagens em outros lugares
components.description_en: Compare landscapes from students' own places of experience to landscapes in other places

cc_matches.description: Compare multiple solutions designed to slow or prevent wind or water from changing the shape of the land.

Earth’s major systems are the geosphere (solid and molten rock, soil, and sediments), the hydrosphere (water and ice), the atmosphere (air), and the biosphere (living things, including humans). These systems interact in multiple ways to affect Earth’s surface materials and processes. The ocean supports a variety of ecosystems and organisms, shapes landforms, and influences climate. Winds and clouds in the atmosphere interact with the landforms to determine patterns of weather.
